t: You're looking at 15 Cheyne Walk, a Grade II* listed house in Chelsea, built in 1718. It was originally called Carlton House, and it is considered a replica of number 4 Cheyne Walk. Catherine Courtney, Baroness Courtney of Penwith, known as Kate, lived here. She was a social worker and internationalist. With her husband Leonard she campaigned to end the Second Boer War and the First World War. She drew attention to the plight of citizens of enemy nations, and was denounced for it as overly sympathetic to the enemy.
